g.text: Rate = new bests / eligible retries · S = distinct contributors

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #685c52

g.text: Color: share of retries setting a new best

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Five equal-duration bins within each homework; bin duration differs between homeworks.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Strict new bests only, after a baseline and before full credit. Counts are repeated events.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Hatched cells are withheld, not zero (<5 students or secondary suppression).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Configured deadlines; individual extensions unavailable. Timing is not a deadline effect.
